title:
Million dollar flats:
*what they share*

lines.say: You're wondering how an HDB flat sells for over a million dollars. Most of them share a few things.
lines.cap: *$1M* HDB flats share a few things

lines.say: Size: most are 4 room, 5 room or executive flats.
Location: towns like Toa Payoh, Bukit Merah and Queenstown lead the count.
Lease: many are newer flats, just past their minimum occupation period.
And high floors near an MRT tend to fetch the most.
They're now spreading to towns like Tampines, Punggol and Woodlands.
Curious if your flat has these traits? Comment CHECK.

caption:
How does an HDB flat sell for over $1 million? Most share a few things. 🏠

Size: mostly 4 room, 5 room or executive. Location: Toa Payoh, Bukit Merah and Queenstown lead the count. Lease: many are newer flats just past MOP. High floors near an MRT tend to fetch the most. And they're spreading to towns like Tampines, Punggol and Woodlands.
